title: Rational power series and finite-dimensional shift span
statement:
Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], $T$ an indeterminate and $f=\sum_{n\geq0}c_nT^n\in K[[T]]$ a formal power series [def-weil-formal-power-series]. For $m\geq0$ let $R_m=(c_{m+s})_{s\geq0}\in K^{\mathbf Z_{\geq0}}$ be the $m$-th shift of the coefficient sequence, and let $V_f\subseteq K^{\mathbf Z_{\geq0}}$ be the $K$-vector subspace spanned by all $R_m$, $m\geq0$ [def-weil-sequence-subspace]. Then the following are equivalent:

1. there are polynomials $P,Q\in K[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] with $Q(0)=1$ and $Qf=P$ in $K[[T]]$ (polynomials regarded as power series [def-weil-polynomial-as-power-series]);
2. $V_f$ is finite-dimensional [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace].

(For (1)$\Rightarrow$(2): if $Q=1+q_1T+\cdots+q_dT^d$ and $\deg P<m_0$, then $c_n+q_1c_{n-1}+\cdots+q_dc_{n-d}=0$ for $n\geq\max(m_0,d)$, so every $R_m$ lies in the span of $R_0,\ldots,R_{\max(m_0,d)-1}$.)
